passage.label: Nun by pen what inscribe; not Muhammad favor Lord madman; indeed reward uninterrupted; indeed great moral character; see they see; which afflicted devil; indeed Lord most knowing gone astray way most knowing guided; do not obey deniers; wish soften would soften; do not obey worthless habitual swearer; scorner going malicious gossip; preventer good transgressing sinful; cruel moreover illegitimate pretender; because possessor wealth children; verses recited says legends former peoples; brand him upon snout

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

mainSubject.label: Oath by the pen and what is inscribed affirming the Prophet is not mad by his Lord's favour, possessing uninterrupted reward and great moral character; both sides will see who is truly afflicted; the Lord most knowing of the astray and the guided; prohibition of obeying deniers who wish mutual softening, nor every worthless swearer, scorner, gossip-monger, preventer of good, transgressor, sinner, cruel illegitimate pretender emboldened by wealth and children who dismisses recited verses as former legends — he will be branded on the snout

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the snout-branding verdict (16) before the garden-companions parable opens (17); P2 ends with the worldly-versus-hereafter punishment comparison (33) before the righteous-gardens and rhetorical challenges begin (34); P3 runs through the criminal-equation challenge, the shin-uncovering scene and the progressive-leading declaration (34-47); P4 covers Yunus's patience lesson, the evil-eye threat and the closing reminder-to-the-worlds declaration (48-52).
